vocabulary.meaning_en: the coloured part of a plant
vocabulary.example: She picked a red flower from the garden.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a tall plant with a wooden trunk and branches
vocabulary.example: We sat in the shade of a big tree.
vocabulary.note_en: The "trunk" is the main thick part; a "branch" is an arm that grows from it.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small plant like a short tree

vocabulary.meaning_en: the green plant that covers the ground
vocabulary.example: The children played on the grass.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a plant used in cooking or as medicine

vocabulary.example: Mint is my favourite herb.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a tiny grain you put in soil to grow a new plant
vocabulary.example: Plant the seeds in spring.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a tool for digging and moving soil
vocabulary.example: He used a shovel to dig a hole.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a tool with teeth for collecting leaves or making soil flat
vocabulary.example: I raked the dry leaves into a pile.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a tool for breaking soil and removing weeds
vocabulary.example: Use a hoe to remove the weeds.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a container with a spout for watering plants
vocabulary.example: Fill the watering can with water.
vocabulary.note_en: The "spout" is the long part the water comes out of.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a long tube connected to a tap to carry water
vocabulary.example: He watered the lawn with a hose.

vocabulary.meaning_en: coverings that protect your hands
vocabulary.note_ar: a pair of gloves = زوج قفازات
vocabulary.example: Wear gloves when you work in the garden.
vocabulary.note_en: "A pair of gloves" means two gloves, one for each hand.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a container for growing plants
vocabulary.example: She keeps a small cactus in a pot.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the top layer of earth where plants grow
vocabulary.example: This soil is good for tomatoes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to put a seed or plant in the ground
vocabulary.example: We planted a lemon tree last year.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make a hole in the ground

vocabulary.meaning_en: to pour water on a plant

vocabulary.note_en: As a noun, it means the liquid we drink.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to develop and get bigger
vocabulary.example: Tomatoes grow fast in the sun.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to cut off dead or extra branches to help a plant grow
vocabulary.example: Prune the roses in winter.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to collect crops or ripe fruit
vocabulary.example: Farmers harvest the wheat in summer.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the area behind a house
vocabulary.example: The kids are playing in the backyard.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a glass building for growing plants that need protection
vocabulary.example: They grow cucumbers in a greenhouse.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a garden for growing herbs
vocabulary.example: My herb garden has mint and basil.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a garden for growing vegetables
vocabulary.example: We grow carrots in our vegetable garden.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an area of ground where flowers are planted
vocabulary.example: Don't step on the flower bed.

vocabulary.meaning_en: land where fruit trees are grown
vocabulary.example: They own an apple orchard.

vocabulary.meaning_en: decayed plant material used to make soil richer
vocabulary.example: We make compost from fruit peels.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a substance added to soil to help plants grow
vocabulary.example: Too much fertilizer can harm plants.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the light from the sun
vocabulary.example: Most plants need a lot of sunlight.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an area out of direct sunlight
vocabulary.example: Some plants grow well in the shade.

vocabulary.meaning_en: covered with plants that grew without control
vocabulary.example: The old garden was overgrown with weeds.
vocabulary.note_en: "Over" (too much) + "grown": plants have grown too much.

vocabulary.meaning_en: growing naturally without human care
vocabulary.example: Wild flowers grow by the road.

vocabulary.meaning_en: covered with rust
vocabulary.example: The gate was old and rusty.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to put something under the ground
vocabulary.example: The pirates buried the treasure.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to look at something carefully
vocabulary.example: The doctor examined my arm.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a straight line of things or people
vocabulary.example: We planted a row of onions.

vocabulary.meaning_en: fixed in a place and unable to move
vocabulary.example: The key is stuck in the lock.

vocabulary.meaning_en: heavy earth used to make pots
vocabulary.example: She made a bowl out of clay.
vocabulary.note_en: A "clay pot" is a pot made from baked earth.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a happy feeling when worry ends
vocabulary.example: We laughed with relief when we found the keys.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a custom passed down through a family or group
vocabulary.example: Eating together on Fridays is a family tradition.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a dried seed, root or bark used to flavour food
vocabulary.example: Cinnamon is my favourite spice.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to cut a little to make something neat
vocabulary.example: I trim my beard every week.

fine_lines.title: herb vs spice
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلاهما يُستخدم في المطبخ لإضافة النكهة، لكن الفرق في الجزء الذي يُؤخذ من النبات. herb تأتي من الأوراق الخضراء للنبات وتُستخدم طازجة أو مجففة مثل النعناع والريحان والبقدونس. spice تأتي من باقي أجزاء النبات كالبذور والجذور واللحاء، وغالباً تكون مطحونة وليست خضراء، مثل القرفة والفلفل الأسود والزنجبيل.

examples.sentence: Add some fresh herbs like parsley to the salad.
Ginger and cinnamon are popular spices.

fine_lines.explanation_en: Both are used in cooking to add flavour, but they come from different parts of the plant. "Herbs" come from the green leaves and are used fresh or dried, like mint, basil and parsley. "Spices" come from other parts like seeds, roots and bark; they are usually ground and not green, like cinnamon, black pepper and ginger.

fine_lines.title: prune vs cut vs trim
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الثلاثة فيها معنى القطع. prune تقليم لهدف صحي: إزالة الأغصان الميتة أو المريضة ليعطي النبات طاقة لينمو ويثمر أفضل. cut فعل عام يعني فصل جزء عن جزء بأداة دون هدف محدد، وقد يشمل قطع الشجرة كلها. trim قصّ الأطراف من أجل الشكل والمظهر فقط، كما تقص شعرك أو لحيتك عند الحلاق.

examples.sentence: You must prune the dead branches on the tree.
They cut down the old tree for wood.
He cuts the grass every Saturday.
The gardener trims the bushes to make them look neat.

fine_lines.explanation_en: All three are about cutting. To "prune" is to cut for the plant's health: removing dead or sick branches so the plant can grow and give fruit better. To "cut" is a general verb for separating something with a tool, with no special purpose, and it can mean cutting down a whole tree. To "trim" is to cut the edges just to make something look neat, like when a barber trims your hair or beard.

fine_lines.title: garden vs yard
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المساحة المحيطة بالبيت تُسمى garden غالباً في بريطانيا، أما في أمريكا فالكلمة الشائعة yard (و backyard للخلفية). في أمريكا garden تعني غالباً المكان المزروع بالزهور أو الخضروات.

examples.sentence: We had tea in the garden.
The dog is running around the yard.

fine_lines.explanation_en: In Britain, the area around a house is usually called a "garden". In America, the common word is "yard" ("backyard" for the area behind). In America, "garden" usually means an area where flowers or vegetables are grown.

expressions.meaning_ar: يقضي على المشكلة في بدايتها قبل أن تكبر
expressions.example: We need to nip this argument in the bud before it ruins our friendship.
expressions.meaning_en: to stop a problem at the start, before it grows

expressions.example: Who will take care of the plants while we're away?
expressions.meaning_en: to look after someone or something

expressions.example: They laughed with relief when the test was cancelled.
expressions.meaning_en: to laugh because a worry or fear has ended

expressions.example: I bought a new pair of gloves for the garden.
expressions.meaning_en: two gloves, one for each hand

expressions.example: This is more than just a job for me.
expressions.meaning_en: not only; something more important than it seems

grammar.title: Future continuous for guessing what is happening now
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم will be + فعل ing أيضاً لتخمين حدث مستمر في اللحظة الحالية لا نراه بأعيننا. المعنى هنا ليس المستقبل بل «أكيد هو الآن يفعل كذا». إذا كنا نرى الحدث أمامنا ولسنا نخمّن، نستخدم المضارع المستمر.
examples: Don't call Ahmed now. He'll be sleeping.
Mum will be cooking in the kitchen right now.
Sarah will be watering the plants at 2. / Look, she is watering them now.
grammar.explanation_en: We also use will be + verb-ing to guess what someone is probably doing right now when we can't see it. Here it doesn't mean the future; it means "I'm sure he's doing this now". If we can actually see the action and aren't guessing, we use the present continuous.

questions.question: Mint, basil and parsley are:
questions.explanation_ar: تأتي من الأوراق الخضراء فهي herbs.
questions.explanation_en: They come from green leaves, so they are herbs.

questions.question: Cinnamon and black pepper are:
questions.explanation_ar: تأتي من اللحاء والبذور فهي spices.
questions.explanation_en: They come from bark and seeds, so they are spices.

questions.question: You should ___ the dead branches so the tree grows better.
questions.explanation_ar: إزالة الأغصان الميتة لهدف صحي = prune.
questions.explanation_en: Removing dead branches for the plant's health is "prune".

questions.question: The gardener ___ the bushes to make them look neat.
questions.explanation_ar: القص من أجل الشكل والمظهر = trim.
questions.explanation_en: Cutting for a neat appearance is "trim".

questions.question: It's 11 p.m. and Ahmed always sleeps early. "Don't call him. He ___."
questions.explanation_ar: نخمّن حدثاً مستمراً الآن فنستخدم will be sleeping.
questions.explanation_en: We're guessing about an action happening now, so we use "will be sleeping".

questions.question: "To nip something in the bud" means to:
choices: stop a problem early before it grows
questions.explanation_ar: معناها القضاء على المشكلة في بدايتها.
questions.explanation_en: It means stopping a problem at the start.

questions.question: A piece of land where fruit trees grow is an:
questions.explanation_en: An orchard is a piece of land with fruit trees.

questions.question: Which tool do you use to collect dry leaves?
questions.explanation_ar: rake أداة لها أسنان لجمع الأوراق الجافة.
questions.explanation_en: A rake has teeth for collecting dry leaves.

questions.question: In American English, the area behind a house is usually called the:
questions.explanation_ar: الأمريكيون يقولون yard / backyard والبريطانيون garden.
questions.explanation_en: Americans say "yard / backyard"; British people say "garden".

questions.question: The old shovel was covered in rust. It was:
